legend: Islands of highly cellular and poorly differentiated epithelium lying in a stromal component producing abundant dentinoid.
The epithelial component shows high cellularity, some pleomorphism and hyperchromatism, and frequent mitoses.
The ectomesenchymal component shows hypercellularity, some pleomorphism, hyperchromatism, increased mitoses, and extensive dentinoid.
Axial CT shows a large, expansile, radiolucent lesion of the left mandible, with cortical destruction.
